subject: Archer portal: post-onboarding evidence sanitization & TTL confirmation
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Nina Patel <nina.patel@archercloud.com>; security@archercloud.com
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Archer portal: post-onboarding evidence sanitization & TTL confirmation

Hi Nina,

Thanks for getting the Archer profile live — appreciate the quick turnaround. Two follow-ups from our side as we wrap the onboarding sprint: 

1) We found a few PII-bearing artifacts in the initial upload (employee PII in a sysadmin-hosting diagram PDF). Can your team provide a sanitized bundle with a redaction log? We need the version we share with procurement and our SOC 2 assessors to be PII-free.

2) For ongoing evidence hygiene, what TTL do you apply to evidence artifacts in the portal? We prefer a 12-month rotation policy with timestamps and a way to pull a historical manifest if needed for audits.

For context: our security reviewers (Mina) will sign off once we have the sanitized package and a short attestation that no live credentials or secrets were embedded in any of the files. Can you please confirm ETA?

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: (none in this message)

From: Nina Patel <nina.patel@archercloud.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: security@archercloud.com, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2027 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Archer portal: post-onboarding evidence sanitization & TTL confirmation

Hi Karthik — Thanks for the note and heads-up.

We’re pulling the bundle now and will run automated PII redaction + a manual review. Plan: upload a sanitized bundle (archer-evidence-bundle_v1.zip) plus a redaction log to the profile by EOD Monday (6/14). The redaction log will list file-by-file actions and a rationale for each redaction.

Regarding TTL: the portal defaults to a 24-month retention for uploaded evidence, but we can set a customer-specific retention (12 months) for the Redwood profile and enable a manifest export for audit purposes. I’ll include retention metadata and the manifest export link in our upload note.

Also: we don’t store any active secrets in uploaded artifacts, but we will run an additional scan for embedded keys and return an attestation.

Best,
Nina Patel
Vendor Security Manager
ArcherCloud

Attachments: archer-evidence-bundle_v1.zip (archive, 42MB)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2027 12:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Archer portal: post-onboarding evidence sanitization & TTL confirmation

Got it — thanks for the quick response, Nina. Once we get the sanitized bundle + redaction log I’ll run a light validation pass (search for email addresses, SSNs, and credential patterns). If anything still looks off I’ll flag specific filenames.

Mina
Sr. Security Ops
Redwood Inference

(Will we need a short MOU to lock the 12-month TTL? Happy to draft if needed.)

From: Nina Patel <nina.patel@archercloud.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Archer portal: post-onboarding evidence sanitization & TTL confirmation

Hi team — uploaded:
- archer-evidence-bundle_v1.zip (sanitized, redaction placeholders inserted where diagrams contained PII)
- archer-evidence-bundle_v1.redaction-log.txt (file-by-file entries)

Portal note includes: retention-policy=12m, manifest-export-id=MANIFEST-20270614-ARCHER-ACME
We also ran a secrets-scan and attached the attestation (scan summary included in redaction log). There were two instances of credentials in a historical snapshot; both were redacted and replaced with placeholders. No active keys were present on our platform.
Please review and let me know if you need us to reformat any files for your SOC 2 assessor.

Nina

Attachments: archer-evidence-bundle_v1.redaction-log.txt

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Nina Patel <nina.patel@archercloud.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 13:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Archer portal: post-onboarding evidence sanitization & TTL confirmation

Thanks, Nina — quick checklist from our end after an initial pass: 
- Redaction log looks comprehensive.
- Please replace the PNG diagram (network-diagram-final.png) with a vector/SVG that has the layers flattened to remove embedded metadata (we saw author/username metadata).
- Can you add a created_at UTC timestamp to the manifest export entries? Our auditors prefer explicit UTC times.

If that’s doable this afternoon we can mark the vendor profile as "SOC 2 sharing approved" in our tracker.

Marcus
Security Controls Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: (none)

From: Nina Patel <nina.patel@archercloud.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Archer portal: post-onboarding evidence sanitization & TTL confirmation

Marcus / Karthik / Mina — thanks for the notes. Uploaded new bundle (archer-evidence-bundle_v2.zip) with:
- network-diagram-final.svg (flattened, metadata scrubbed)
- manifest entries with created_at in UTC
- updated redaction log entry for the PNG -> SVG replacement

We’ve also toggled the retention setting on your profile to 12 months and enabled a daily manifest snapshot export to the Drive link you provided.

If everything looks good, I’ll add a portal comment attesting to "no active secrets" and move the profile to the shared-audit group so your assessors can pull artifacts.

Nina

Attachments: archer-evidence-bundle_v2.zip (archive, 38MB)
